summary: Iter-22 Phase 2 verification of three UI bug fixes (wishlist badge, wishlist hydration after refresh, merchant edit modal prefill) + regression smoke. All 3 bugs are FIXED. Backend regression (4/4 pytest) and admin/Phase-4 tabs smoke (9/9) both pass.

issues: Multiple 400/404 'Failed to load resource' entries appear on every consumer page load (visible in console). They do not impact functionality but should be investigated — likely an image/analytics 404 or a similar-products endpoint returning 400/404 for some product IDs.

evidence: After clicking first p-card Add button (cart += 1): wishlist-badge still absent.
After clicking first heart toggle: wishlist-badge appears with text '1'.

bug_2_wishlist_persists_after_hard_refre.method: Direct localStorage hydration test (OTP WhatsApp daily limit hit on shared sandbox; backend logs print [OTP-DEBUG] but Twilio is 429-blocked; verified the store-level fix end-to-end by planting bf_customer_phone + bf_wishlist_<phone> and reloading).
evidence: With bf_customer_phone='919876543201' + bf_wishlist_919876543201=[product] planted, hard-navigate to /wishlist → wishlist-card-prod-test-abc123 rendered, wishlist-badge=1, no empty state.
After removing bf_customer_phone (signed-out), /wishlist shows 'No product added in your wishlist' as expected.
Confirms initialPhone() + customer-auth:change + storage listeners in wishlist.store.ts work.
Logged in as menscape@lokl.demo / Demo@2026, /merchant/products lists 13 products, 13 edit-product-<id> buttons present.

Clicked edit-product-prod-demo-2c67331c (Slim-fit Cotton Shirt). Modal opened with: name='Slim-fit Cotton Shirt', price='1199', mrp='1799', desc='Slim-fit Cotton Shirt — curated by Menscape.', gender=Men, category=Shirts, sizes S/M/L/XL highlighted, stock 6/4/5/5, cover image present.
Confirms r.data.product unwrap fix at openEdit (~line 144).
POST /api/admin/complaints/INVALID/resolve with admin token → 404 'Complaint not found'.
Newest order LOKL-0975385F matches ^LOKL-[0-9A-F]{8}$ (older BFO- ids are legacy, as expected).
Demo merchant Menscape products endpoint reachable (13 products).
Admin login (admin@lokl.in / Admin@2026) succeeded, landed on /admin Overview.
All 9 tabs visible: Overview, Live, Merchants, Bank/Address, Stores, Products, Orders, Returns, Customers.
Note: actual label is 'Bank/Address' (slash) — test request used 'Bank-Address' (hyphen). Cosmetic only.

action_items: (Optional) Investigate the recurring 400/404 'Failed to load resource' entries that appear on every consumer page load. They do not block any user flow but they litter the browser console.

(Optional) For exhaustive OTP-flow tests in CI, the WhatsApp sandbox hits the 50/day cap quickly. Consider gating the OTP UI smoke test behind a feature flag or stubbing the channel when [OTP] All channels failed is observed.
critical_code_review_comments: wishlist.store.ts initialPhone() correctly reads bf_customer_phone on module init AND attaches both 'storage' (cross-tab) and 'customer-auth:change' (same-tab) listeners — the fix is robust and matches the spec.
StickyBottomNav.tsx now reads useWishlistStore.products.length (subscribed via Zustand selector) — re-renders correctly when the bucket changes. data-testid 'wishlist-badge' is in place.

merchant/products/page.tsx openEdit unwraps r.data.product. Good. Type cast inline is hard to read; consider extracting a ProductDetailResponse type alias to share between this page and any other caller of GET /api/products/{pid}.
Minor: openEdit catches and toasts errors but does NOT clear editingId/openAdd state on failure — if the GET fails the modal could remain closed but editingId could leak. Low priority.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@lokl.in / Admin@2026 — verified. Demo merchant: menscape@lokl.demo / Demo@2026 — verified. Customer OTP: backend [OTP-DEBUG] logs work but Twilio sandbox 429s past 50/day; the per-tab UI test was therefore done via localStorage planting which exercises the same store-level code path as a real login.
seed_data_creation: Planted one synthetic wishlist entry (prod-test-abc123) in localStorage only — not persisted on backend. No DB seed changes.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All three iter-46 (Phase 2) fixes verified. Wishlist bucket keys: bf_wishlist_guest, bf_wishlist_<phone>; customer phone at bf_customer_phone; event names: 'customer-auth:change' (same tab) + native 'storage' (cross tab).
